modes.name: Easy (Standard)
rules: Rounds 1–40, 200 lives.
Towers cost 15% less than Medium.
The round 40 MOAB has a third less health on Easy.
strategy: Any reasonable defense works; it's the place to learn maps.
Save for one answer to the round 40 MOAB.

modes.name: Primary Only
rules: Easy rules (rounds 1–40), but only Primary towers and your hero.
strategy: Only Enhanced Eyesight, Cold Snap and Eagle Eye give Primary towers camo; leads need Bomb Shooters, Red Hot Rangs or Hot Shots.
The only blimp is the round 40 MOAB: a MOAB Assassin far from the track one-shots it, so don't overspend on anti-MOAB.
Hardest on Flooded Valley, where the dam blocks most Primary towers.

towers.note: The strongest pick: Spear pops leads, Vision handles the round 33–37 camos, Ancestral Might beats round 40.
Gets camo and lead popping on time if placed at the start.
Innate camo, lead popping from her level 3 ability.
A Rare Quincy Action Figure bought on round 1 is worth about $9,700 by round 31.
One-shots the only MOAB.

modes.name: Deflation
rules: Start on round 31 with $20,000 (no income at all) and finish round 60.
Selling works normally; Continues, Perks and Fast Track are disabled.
strategy: Build the whole defense on the first round and cover every bloon type (camo purples on 45 and 48, camo leads on 59).
Skip tier-2 towers other than Villages: a few strong tier 3–4s beat many tier 2s.
Trick: buy Monkey Commerce first, place everything in its range for the discount, upgrade, then sell the Commerce village.
Jungle Drums, Berserker Brew and Stronger Stimulant are worth it almost always. Income towers are useless.

towers.note: 5-2-0 is affordable with More Cash and can solo to round 60 on most maps.
Three 2-0-3s with a 4-0-0 Stronger Stimulant and a 0-2-0 Village beat it on nearly every map.
0-2-4 with a 3-2-0 Berserker Brew coasts through.
3-2-0 with a 3-2-0 Berserker Brew and camo; Brickell is the hero to pair.
2-3-0 carries maps without line-of-sight blockers if camo and purple are covered.

modes.name: Medium (Standard)
rules: Rounds 1–60, 150 lives, normal tower prices.
Bloons move 10% faster than Easy.
strategy: Farm early, then build a mid-game carry; the round 60 BFB is the final check.

modes.name: Military Only
rules: Medium rules (rounds 1–60), but only Military towers and your hero. No Banana Farms.
strategy: Every Military tower has a cheap camo upgrade; Submerge and Support and Signal Flare strip camo.
Full Metal Jacket is the easiest lead answer; Hot Shot and Heat-tipped Darts also pop leads.
Unlike Primary Only, you can't leak every camo and still win.

towers.note: 3-2-0 Destroyer is one of the best early-mid towers; Flagship all but guarantees the win.
A cheap finisher whose hook one-shots the round 60 BFB.
Shreds MOABs on water maps, best with Brickell.
Stuns MOABs so the rest of your defense gets more hits.
The best hero on water maps.
Helps save for expensive Military tier 5s.

modes.name: Apopalypse
rules: Medium rules with random, harder rounds that never stop: you must act mid-round.
Stalling gains nothing.
strategy: Get your hero early; have answers for camo, lead, zebra and purple by about rounds 12–20.
Farm (a Monkey Bank) in the 20s–30s, finish farming by about round 35, and sell farms when the first MOAB appears.
Late game, rely on Artillery Battery, Aircraft Carrier or BADS; Spectre if you farmed enough.

towers.note: 3-2-0 with Berserker Brew and camo.
2-0-2 coverage, into Triple Guns or Armor Piercing Darts.
Often better than farms mid-late game because leads are so common.
Benjamin for income; Geraldo for flexibility.

modes.name: Reverse
rules: Medium rules, but bloons travel the track backwards and each round's groups come in reverse order.
strategy: Barely changes most maps; normal Medium strategies work.
Past round 60, rounds 63 (densest clump first), 78 (camo Ceramics) and 95 (no warm-up) get harder.
Dark Castle (Spike Factories weaker) and Workshop (bloons go up the MOAB path) get notably harder.

modes.name: Hard (Standard)
rules: Rounds 3–80, 100 lives, towers cost 8% more than Medium.
Bloons move 25% faster than Easy.
strategy: The best mode for earning XP and Monkey Knowledge before the harder Hard modes.
Prepare for rounds 40, 63, 75, 76 and 78 (see the CHIMPS playbook for counters).

modes.name: Magic Monkeys Only
rules: Hard rules (rounds 3–80), but only Magic towers and your hero.
strategy: Get plenty of Monkey Knowledge first; beating Hard Standard on many maps helps.
Danger rounds: 40 (MOAB), 63 (Ceramic waves), 75 (BFB packs and fortified MOABs), 76, 78.

towers.note: A Rare Quincy Action Figure bought before round 10 is worth over $23,000 by round 60; See Invisibility Potion handles camos.
Buffs Magic towers, especially Druids; Wall of Trees tanks and pays out.
With Berserker Brew it pops every type early; later a 20× Shinobi army.

towers.upgrade: Druid of the Storm / Ball Lightning
towers.note: Strong support and cleanup for the cost, especially with Obyn.

modes.name: Double HP MOABs
rules: Hard rules, but every MOAB-class bloon has double health (stacks with fortification).
strategy: Only slightly harder than Hard Standard and identical early, apart from rounds 40 and 50.
The round 40 MOAB is even more of a run-killer: bring a strong answer.
Blimp-damage towers gain value after the early game.

towers.note: Listed as a strong round 40 answer.
Listed as a strong round 40 answer.

Heroes listed as strong round 40 answers.

modes.name: Half Cash
rules: Hard rules, but almost all cash is halved: starting cash, pops, round bonus and tower income.
Exceptions: Monkey Bank interest, Geraldo's Rare Quincy Action Figure, Corvus' Nourishment, Bananite crystals and the Havoc Staff are unaffected.
strategy: Arguably the most frustrating mode; get lots of Monkey Knowledge first (Bonus Monkey!, More Cash, Mana Shield, Military Conscription, Veteran Monkey Training).
Your hero matters most: Corvus is the strongest. Place towers you'll upgrade later rather than sell.
Use several cheap towers over one expensive tier 5. Cheap buffs (Jungle Drums, Berserker Brew, Stronger Stimulant) are key.
There are no Super Ceramics, so grouped-damage towers that struggle in CHIMPS (Recursive Cluster, M.O.A.R Glaives, Ring of Fire) gain value.

towers.note: Strong at every stage and very versatile.
Recommended for most maps.
Cheap control and support.
Cheap grouped damage with no Super Ceramics to worry about.
Recommended for most maps.
Recommended for most maps.

modes.name: Alternate Bloons Rounds
rules: Hard rules with redesigned, harder rounds: strong bloon types and camos appear much earlier. Win after round 80.
strategy: Cover every bloon type early (lead, purple, camo, zebra); radar and decamo matter more than usual.
Danger rounds: 10 (early leads), 27 (huge camo rush), 30 (camo leads), 40 (fortified MOAB), 50, 63 (with camo Ceramics), 75 (arguably the hardest).
Once everything is covered, farm properly; cheap buffs are very useful.

modes.name: Impoppable
rules: Rounds 6–100 with one life (no Mana Shield).
Towers cost 20% more than Medium.
After round 80, Ceramics become Super Ceramics and bloons gradually speed up.
strategy: Rounds 95 and 98 appear, so plan a real late game; farm well but not excessively.
Geraldo is recommended on every map; Benjamin snowballs income. Monkeyopolis (2-0-5) is the main money-maker.
Late carries: Flying Fortress (2-0-5 with a 2-2-0 Village), Ray of Doom, BEZ, Pouākai; sell Recursive Cluster, Ring of Fire and Crossbow Master around round 81.

towers.note: Recommended on every map.
The main money-maker (2-0-5).
The main late-game carry.
Tanks huge numbers of bloons (1-0-5 with Jungle Drums and a 3-0-1 brew).

modes.name: CHIMPS
rules: Rounds 6–100 with one life and no Continues, Hearts lost, Income, Monkey Knowledge, Powers or Selling.
strategy: Farms, Merchantmen, Monkey City and Benjamin give nothing: every dollar comes from popping, so spend on defense that also scales into the late game.
Nothing can be sold, so avoid towers you'll outgrow; plan your win condition early (the CHIMPS tier list ranks them).

The danger rounds to prepare for: R40 first MOAB, R63 Ceramic waves, R75 Fortified MOABs and BFBs, R78 camo Ceramics, R90 camo regrow leads and DDTs, R95 DDT rush, R98 Fortified BFBs and ZOMGs, R99, and the R100 B.A.D. The CHIMPS & Bosses tab has counters for each.

modes.name: Freeplay
rules: Keep playing after winning a standard game; bloons get faster and tougher every round past 80.
Selling, income and Monkey Knowledge all work.
strategy: Farm instead of over-building defense for the first 100 rounds: Banana Central, BRF spam, Monkeyopolis and Overclocks.
Bloonjitsu spam with about 20 Shinobi Tactics stacks each is the top late build, with Grandmaster Ninja and Grand Saboteur.
Paragons with high degrees, Ezili against late BADs and Homeland Defense as support.

towers.note: The standard late-Freeplay damage build.
Income for the first 100 rounds.
Strong against late BADs.
